in_marathi.name: Atiurv
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atiurv हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Atiurv is derived from Sanskrit roots 'ati' meaning 'revered' and 'urv' meaning 'ancient'. This name holds significant importance in Hindu mythology as it is believed to represent the reverence for ancient wisdom and knowledge.
